decision_conditions: Prior to superstructure works, detailed specification, a drainage layout and a management & maintenance plan (where applicable) of at least one suitable sustainable drainage system (i.e. water butt with overflow, raingarden, bioretention planter box, living roof (substrate depth of 80- 150mm excluding the vegetative mat), permeable paving etc.) shall be submitted to, and approved by the LPA, in consultation with the LLFA. If soakaways i.e. plastic modules and soakaway rings are used, an infiltration test must be carried out to ensure that the capacity of the soil is suitable for infiltration. It must be demonstrated that there will be no increase in surface water flow being discharged offsite and an overall reduction in peak flow rate and volume.Reason: In the interest of sustainable urban drainage.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until at least one swift brick or nesting box suitable for sparrows or starlings has been installed at the property in accordance with the manufacturer's specification.The biodiversity enhancement installed shall be thereafter retained.REASON: In the interests of promoting biodiversity at the site.

The roof lights on the front roof slope must be conservation style and must be retained for the duration of the development.REASON: To preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the conservation area.

<p>All new external facing and roofing materials in respect of all the works hereby approved (and any other incidental works carried out in this connection) shall match those of the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance including type, size, colour, bond, pointing, coursing, jointing, profile and texture.&nbsp;</p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-8341e06b-7fff-31f3-f6b5-c23f1f37721e">REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.</span></p>

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The Development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 18(a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 as amended.

<p>The roof of the proposed extension and any flat roof at the property hereby approved shall not be used as a terrace, balcony or similar amenity area.</p><p>REASON: In the interests of neighbours amenity</p>
description: Erection of a ground floor wrap-around extension with sukkah roof, erection of a rear dormer roof extension with the insertion of x2 rooflights
